storySession.fullStory: You and Maya need to reach the cabin before dark, so you start your búsqueda (search) by following the overgrown path ahead. The path leads to a broken bridge, and you spot a flat-roofed storage shed nearby; you climb onto its techo (roof) to see the terrain beyond. From up there, you notice a torn backpack caught on a post below—Maya retrieves it and finds a cremallera (zipper) still working on one pocket. Inside the pocket is a map showing a shortcut, but it crosses a ravine; you and Maya use the old juego (game) of balancing on fallen logs to test which ones will hold your weight. You find one solid log and roll a rueda (wheel) from the shed to act as a pulley; threading a rope through it lets you both lower yourselves safely down. Reaching the ravine floor feels like a logro (achievement), but the path ahead is blocked by a landslide. You mix pegamento (glue) you find in the shed with bark to seal cracks in a wooden board, then use it as a bridge across the slippery lodo (mud). You step across carefully, Maya follows, and together you reach the cabin as the light fades.
